question: May this project read NFL.com pages on a schedule and store the values?
answer_we_have: No. Terms §1.3 (carried verified read) limits use to individual non-commercial informational use and bars systematic retrieval to compile a database without prior written consent.
information_missing: a written reply from NFL Enterprises naming this use
blocks: every automated or multi-day capture: price archive, Wed/Thu/Fri injury cadence, daily depth/IR sweep
discovery_route: send one written request describing the exact use; publish the reply verbatim, or publish the refusal and stop capturing
would_change_the_answer_if: a licence or written consent, or a licensed data vendor
